title: Audit Range filter visual depth
description: Re-audit Range after the recent fixes, covering single-bar dual-handle variants, vertical labels, inputs, handles, icon overlays, alignment, and field binding.
objective: Turn Range into one audited component among many, with implementation depth based on code findings rather than the latest screenshot only.
expected_outputs: Variant list including two-input, single-bar dual handle, vertical, compact, and numeric-only modes
acceptance_criteria: The audit confirms whether the label on/off switch is respected in vertical and horizontal states.
The audit evaluates alignment controls for vertical Range, not only color/shape.
The audit identifies which Range variants are feasible with native inputs and which require custom UI.
The audit ties Range field binding to generic numeric fields, not only price.
verification: Findings cite current CSS, JS, PHP render, and Style control IDs.
No Range fixes are implemented by this task.

budgets.context_budget: recent Range tasks, source map, containment and binding reports
budgets.research_budget: local code and punctual browser checks if needed

risks: Range can keep absorbing all visual work unless this report explicitly demotes it back to one component in the matrix.
